text:
jess: Heads-up — tenant migration next Wed. we need a plan for shim eviction and fallback behavior when the old proxy is drained. current default is idle TTL=15m + mem-pressure LRU, but that causes noisy retries during cutover.

liam: +1. noisy retries = alerts + customer impact. what do we own vs what the client should handle?

omar: From infra side I'd prefer explicit drain hook that marks the tenant as migrating then triggers graceful eviction window (e.g. 10m), rather than immediate LRU. we can also stamp telemetry "shim.eviction.reason" = migration to distinguish.

sara: For compatibility shims specifically, sticky KV cache persistence across model variants would reduce cold starts, but risky for correctness if model vocab/kv layout changes. maybe only persist for minor-version-compatible variants.

jess: agree on minor-version policy. proposal: when migration flag is flipped we set shim.state = "migrating", send retention-grace = 8m, allow in-flight to finish, heavy requests get routed to fallback model variant, then evict. if memory pressure before 8m, prefer evict non-migrating tenants first.

liam: Implementation notes: add tenant tag to allocator and eviction scorer. scoring order: (1) non-migrating LRU, (2) migrating by idle time, (3) pinned/priority tenants last. Keep config knobs: migration_grace_secs, prefer_local_cache bool.

omar: edge-case: what if client retries on 503 and ends up hitting fallback repeatedly causing extra cost? suggestion: add transient 409 with "migrating" header so client can backoff rather than immediate fallback.

sara: hmm 409 semantics might confuse clients. alternative: return 200 from shim with structured payload {"service_migrating":true, "fallback": "recommended", "ttl": 480} so SDK can implement soft-fallback/backoff logic.

jess: Love structured payload idea. SDKs can inspect and choose backoff vs immediate fallback. We should document the header + body shape in the migration playbook.

liam: ops concern — need logs that show 3 things: eviction reason, last route, kv-cache-hit-rate at time of eviction. add metric labels: tenant_id, shard, shim_version, eviction_reason.

omar: +1. Also add event in audit stream so Private customers can see migrations as discrete events. keep audit_event = {tenant, start_ts, end_ts, evicted_shims: n}.

sara: quick config snippet for rollout (proposal):

```yaml
migration_grace_secs: 480
eviction_policy:
  prefer_non_migrating: true
  fallback_on_migrate: true
  client_signal: structured_body
minor_version_persist_cache: true
```

jess: who wants to own the RFC follow-up? need a short doc with: rationale, config knobs, SDK contract, metrics, playbook steps, release checklist. target PR by EOD Fri.

liam: I can draft the config + metrics sections.

omar: I will add allocator/eviction implementation details and tests.

sara: I'll write the SDK contract section and example client backoff pseudocode.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging/proxy-shim:v2026-03-25 deployed to staging (sha: d4f3c) :rocket:

jess: cool — please link PRs here when ready. we should also run a small internal canary (5 tenants) before full migration. :eyes:
